youtube.title: What happens to the world economy when GTA 6 drops?
youtube.description:
One video game vs the entire world economy. 💸
Its older brother made $1 billion in three days, one delay wiped billions off the stock market, and launch day could cost a billion dollars in sick days.
What's your launch day plan? Comment A, B or C 👇

Sources: Guinness World Records / Take-Two (first game: $1B in 3 days, 2013) · DFC Intelligence via Financial Times ($3.2B first-year forecast) · José Montalvo, Pompeu Fabra University (≈1.5M sick days ≈ $1B, estimate) · World Bank / NSB Bhutan (GDP ≈ $3.3B, 2024)
